headline: US Dollar Holds Steady While Yen Gains Ahead of Nonfarm Payrolls
summary: The US dollar held its ground and the Japanese yen gained as an equity market rout sapped risk appetite among investors ahead of the upcoming employment payroll report.
why: The US employment payrolls report is a critical macroeconomic indicator closely watched by the Federal Reserve and currency traders for monetary policy direction.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: The US dollar held steady ahead of payroll data releases.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding upcoming employment data and reduced risk appetite drove safe-haven currency flows into the yen.
